title: evelyd/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions
abstract:
SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning

SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning Evelyn D'Elia 1,2 , Weishu Zhan 2 , Giulio Turrisi 3 , Giulio Romualdi 4 , Giuseppe L'Erario 4 , Raffaello Camoriano 5,6 , Wei Pan 7 , Daniele Pucci 4 1 IIT@MIT, Italian Institute of Technology (IIT), Genoa, Italy 2 Machine Learning and Optimisation, University of Manchester, U.K. 3 Dynamic Legged Systems Laboratory, IIT, Genoa, Italy 4 Generative Bionics S.R.L, Genoa, Italy 5 DAUIN, Politecnico di Torino, Turin, Italy 6 Rehab Technologies Lab, IIT, Genoa, Italy 7 School of Engineering, Newcastle University, U.K. E. D'Elia, G. Romualdi, G. L'Erario, and D. Pucci contributed to this work while at the Artificial and Mechanical Intelligence lab, IIT, Italy. W. Pan contributed to this work while at the Machine Learning and Optimisation group, University of Manchester, U.K. 📅 Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) ## Overview We propose, SKooP, an RL-based approach which leverages Koopman model predictions and morphological symmetries to achieve faster policy convergence and better sample efficiency. This repository allows the reproduction of the paper results for the following approaches: - **PPO** (` `) - **PPOeqic** (` _emlp`) - **SKooP-NoSym-NoPred** (` _cdae_online`) - **SKooP-NoSym** (` _cdae_online_next_latent`) - **SKooP-NoPred** (` _emlp_ecdae_online`) - **SKooP** (` _emlp_ecdae_online_next_latent`) ### Supported Tasks - Stand Dance - Walk Slope - Push Door ## Installation ### Prerequisites - Python 3.8+ - CUDA 11.3 compatible GPU (optional, can run on CPU) ### Step 1: Create Conda Environment ### Step 2: Install PyTorch ### Step 3: Install Isaac Gym 1. Download Isaac Gym Preview 4 from [NVIDIA Developer](https://developer.nvidia.com/isaac-gym) 2. Extract the archive: 3. Install the Python package: ### Step 4: Install Project Dependencies ### Step 5: Install Additional Dependencies ##
abstract_zh: 我们提出了SKooP，一种基于强化学习的方法，利用Koopman模型预测和形态对称性来实现更快的策略收敛和更好的样本效率。该仓库允许复现以下方法的论文结果：PPO、PPOeqic、SKooP-NoSym-NoPred、SKooP-NoSym、SKooP-NoPred和SKooP。支持的任务包括站立舞蹈、斜坡行走和推门。
tldr_zh: SKooP结合Koopman预测与对称性，加速腿式机器人强化学习收敛并提升泛化。
cover_zh: 腿式机器人学得慢？SKooP用对称性+Koopman预测，收敛快还更通用！

judge.reason: 官方IROS论文代码，基于Koopman预测与对称性提升足式机器人RL训练效率，方向吻合且可复现。
